# Purpose and inputs

This report compares the families listed in the **selected** sheet of `CRT_vs_F2F.xlsx` with the UNFCCC CRT 2026 extract. Each workbook row becomes one section, in workbook order: a CRT-versus-FADN2Footprint scatterplot, a country-year relative-error heatmap, then an agreement-metric heatmap. Livestock categories and soil pathways are faceted within their selected family. Emission totals and derived intensities remain separate subgroups, with the same three-plot order.

The workbook controls report selection and ordering, not scientific formulas or source mappings. Existing catalogue identifiers are used for matching; the direct and indirect soil families are expanded to their existing pathway identifiers. Use `selected_path` to override the workbook beside this report. Unselected measures remain in the full comparison exports for traceability.

Per-tonne-meat intensities use public Eurostat slaughtered-meat production from [dataset `apro_mt_pann`](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/apro_mt_pann/default/table), retrieved for the selected countries and years when the report is rendered.

When params\$use_mock == TRUE, the script prepares the published **mock EU FADN data**, using the same constructor, practice inference and GHG routines as real farm data. Mock results are only a workflow demonstration, not scientific validation. All farm types are retained to cover the requested livestock and crop categories. The package has currently been validated only for types 15 and 45; estimates for other types are untested. Set `farm_types: [15, 45]` to restrict to that validated scope, but then the estimates are not whole-sector totals.

Render from the repository root:

``` bash
quarto render inst/validation/validation_report_UNFCCC.qmd
```

To build or refresh the Eurostat population data, run `Rscript inst/scripts/EUROSTAT_livestock_pop.R` from the repository root. It downloads public Eurostat tables in memory and writes `data/EUROSTAT_livestock_pop.rda`; it does not access `data_raw/`. Rebuild any dataset created before the JSON-stat dimension-order correction.

For real data, set `use_mock: false`, `fadn_raw_object_path` to the object returned by `data_4FADN2Footprint()`, and `fadn_object_path` to the object returned by `compute_footprint_ghg()`. Both accept `.rds`, `.RData` or `.rda`; an RData file must contain exactly one `FADN2Footprint` object. Use objects built from the same input dataset. No confidential raw files are loaded in the default mock mode. `years` and `farm_types` apply to both objects; set either to `null` to retain all observations. Use `crt_path` to override the default `AI_agents/outputs/crt_variables_long.csv`.

``` bash
quarto render inst/validation/validation_report_UNFCCC.qmd -P use_mock:false -P fadn_raw_object_path:"C:\data_raw\FADN_EU_17_21_obj.RData" -P fadn_object_path:"C:\data_raw\FADN_EU_17_21_obj_GHGE.RData"
```

CSV exports contain only national aggregates, coverage counts and diagnostics. By default they are written beside the rendered report; use `output_dir` to choose a different directory. Do not commit confidential or real-data exports.

## Package preparation

The constructor object is retained before practice inference. The GHG object is prepared with `infer_practices()` and `compute_footprint_ghg()`, reusing stored results where available. For inventory comparisons, only inventory-relevant GHG components are included: upstream feed, energy and product allocation are not national agriculture inventory emissions and are not added. Soil diagnostics use the standard managed-soils output, which includes activity inputs and component emissions. Manure diagnostics use `return_components = TRUE`. No emission factors are replaced.

```{r prepare_fadn}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

if (isTRUE(params$use_mock)) {
    raw_fadn <- mock_data$fadn_fict
    if (!is.null(params$years)) {
        raw_fadn <- filter(raw_fadn, YEAR %in% params$years)
    }
    if (!is.null(params$farm_types)) {
        raw_fadn <- filter(raw_fadn, TF14 %in% params$farm_types)
    }
    if (!nrow(raw_fadn)) {
        stop("No mock observations satisfy the selected years/farm types.")
    }
    my_object_raw <- data_4FADN2Footprint(raw_fadn)
    my_object_GHGE <- my_object_raw
} else {
    read_fadn_object <- function(path, parameter) {
        if (is.null(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
            stop("Supply an existing ", parameter, " for real mode.")
        }
        if (tolower(tools::file_ext(path)) == "rds") {
            object <- readRDS(path)
        } else {
            input_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
            loaded <- load(path, envir = input_env)
            objects <- loaded[vapply(
                loaded,
                function(nm) inherits(input_env[[nm]], "FADN2Footprint"),
                logical(1)
            )]
            if (length(objects) != 1L) {
                stop("RData must contain exactly one FADN2Footprint object.")
            }
            object <- input_env[[objects]]
        }
        if (!inherits(object, "FADN2Footprint")) {
            stop(parameter, " is not a FADN2Footprint object.")
        }
        if (!is.null(params$years)) {
            object <- m_prune_farms(object, YEAR %in% params$years)
        }
        if (!is.null(params$farm_types)) {
            object <- m_prune_farms(object, TF14 %in% params$farm_types)
        }
        if (!nrow(object@farm)) {
            stop("No farm observations remain in ", parameter, ".")
        }
        object
    }
    my_object_raw <- read_fadn_object(
        params$fadn_raw_object_path, "fadn_raw_object_path"
    )
    my_object_GHGE <- read_fadn_object(
        params$fadn_object_path, "fadn_object_path"
    )
}
if (!nrow(my_object_GHGE@farm)) {
    stop("No farm observations remain.")
}
farms_before <- nrow(my_object_GHGE@farm)
my_object_GHGE <- infer_practices(my_object_GHGE)
if (!nrow(my_object_GHGE@farm)) {
    stop("Practice inference removed every observation.")
}
my_object_GHGE <- compute_footprint_ghg(my_object_GHGE)
cat("Input mode:", if (params$use_mock) "MOCK" else "REAL", "\n")
cat(
    "Farm-years before/after practice inference:",
    farms_before,
    "/",
    nrow(my_object_GHGE@farm),
    "\n"
)
my_object_GHGE@farm |>
    count(COUNTRY, YEAR, name = "sample_farm_years") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(YEAR), y = sample_farm_years, fill = COUNTRY)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Sample farm-years", fill = "Country") +
    labs(title = "Selected FADN sample by country and year") +
    theme_minimal()
```

# Inventory data and matching

The long extract is built from [UNFCCC CRT 2026 submissions](https://unfccc.int/reports?f%5B0%5D=document_type%3A4593&f%5B1%5D=year%3A2026). Matching uses the **sheet, variable label and category code/label**, not Excel coordinates. Canonical parent rows take precedence over uncoded labels, and parent and child values are never added together. Conflicting repeated values are flagged `ambiguous`, rather than arbitrarily selected.

Notation keys (`IE`, `NO`, `NE`, etc.) remain non-numeric. **IE means included elsewhere**, not zero. Missing values and incompatible units prevent numerical differences; unverified unit checks remain visible in the output.

## FADN2Footprint-to-CRT variable map

The tables below documents the source behind each comparison family. FADN2Footprint names refer to the object slots and calculation outputs used by `compare_UNFCCC.R`; the `metric_id` values are the identifiers in the comparison and metrics exports. Farm totals are weighted by `SYS02`. Unless noted otherwise, livestock categories are dairy cattle (`LCOWDAIR`), non-dairy cattle (other cattle), cattle (both groups combined), swine, sheep and poultry. The matching CRT category codes are shown in the last column. A comparison is unavailable when the package does not provide the corresponding distinct quantity.

### List of variables for rescaling

| UNFCCC table | Type | Comparison (`metric_id`) | FADN2Footprint source and construction | UNFCCC CRT source |
|--------------|--------------|--------------|---------------|-----------------|
| Table 3.A | Activity | Livestock population (`population_*`) | `object@herd$Qobs`, classified using `FADN_code_letter` and species; `SYS02`-weighted heads. | Table3.A, **Population size**; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 4.B and Table 4.C | Activity | Land area (`area_cropland`, `area_grassland`) | `object@crop$area_ha`; cropland includes `land_use_type` arable and fallow, and grassland includes `land_use_type` grassland. | Table4.B/Table4.C, **ACTIVITY DATA - Total area**; categories `4.B` (total cropland) and `4.C` (total grassland). Land definitions and FADN coverage may differ. |


### List of variables for agreement testing

| UNFCCC table | Type | Comparison (`metric_id`) | FADN2Footprint source and construction | UNFCCC CRT source |
|--------------|--------------|--------------|---------------|-----------------|
| Table 3.A | Activity | Gross energy intake (`gross_energy_*`) | `f_herd_feed(object)$feed_intake$total$GE_MJ_anim`; weighted mean by `Qobs * SYS02`, converted from MJ/head/year to MJ/head/day by dividing by 365. | Table3.A, **Average gross energy intake**; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 3.B(b) | Activity | Manure N excreted (`n_excreted_*`) | `f_n_excr()` output `Nex_kgN_livcat_y`, converted from kg N to t N and summed by category. | Table3.B(b), **Total N Excreted**; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 3.D | Activity | Soil activity (`soil_activity_*`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_msoils()`: `F_SN` (inorganic), `F_ON` (organic), `F_PRP` (grazing), `F_CR` (crop residues); then weighted by SYS02, rescaled by areas and summed by category. | Table3.D, **ACTIVITY DATA - Value**; categories `3.D.1.a. Inorganic N fertilizers`, `3.D.1.b. Organic N fertilizers`, `3.D.1.c. Urine and dung deposited by grazing animals`, and `3.D.1.d. Crop residues`. |
| Table 3.F | Activity | Crop production (`production_wheat`, `production_barley`, `production_maize`) | `object@crop$area_ha * object@crop$yield`, summed for wheat (`CWHTC`, `CWHTD`), barley (`CBRL`) or grain maize (`CMZ`). | Table3.F, **Crop production**; categories `3.F.1.a` (wheat), `.1.b` (barley) and `.1.c` (maize). CRT production may cover only crops with residues burned; maize is grain maize, not forage maize. |
| Table 3 | Emissions | Total enteric emissions (`enteric_total_*`) | `f_GHGE_ch4_enteric()` output, sum of `CH4_enteric_kgCO2e_livcat`, weighted by SYS02 and rescaled. | Table3, **Total GHG emissions**; category `3.A`. |
| Table 3 | Emissions | Total manure emissions (`manure_total_*`) | `f_GHGE_ch4_manure` and `f_GHGE_n2o_manure` outputs, summing `CH4_MM_kgCO2e_livcat` and direct `N2O_D_MM_kgCO2e_livcat` only, weighted by SYS02 and rescaled. Indirect N2O is compared separately under `3.B.5`. | Table3, **Total GHG emissions**; category `3.B`. |
| Table 3 | Emissions | Total agricultural soils emissions (`soil_total`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_msoils()` output, sum of `N2O_d_kgCO2e`, `N2O_ATD_kgCO2e`, and `N2O_L_kgCO2e`, weighted by SYS02 and rescaled. | Table3, **Total GHG emissions**; category `3.D`. |
| Table 3.A | Emissions | Enteric CH4 (`enteric_ch4_*`) | `f_GHGE_ch4_enteric()` output `CH4_enteric_kgCO2e_livcat`, converted to CH4 using the package `GWP[["CH4"]]`, then weighted by SYS02, rescaled and summed by category. | Table3.A, CH4 **EMISSIONS**; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 3.B(a) | Emissions | Manure CH4 (`manure_ch4_*`) | `f_GHGE_ch4_manure()` output `CH4_MM_kgCO2e_livcat`, converted to CH4 using `GWP[["CH4"]]`, then weighted by SYS02, rescaled and summed by category. | Table3.B(a), CH4 **EMISSIONS**; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 3.B(b) | Emissions | Direct manure N2O (`manure_direct_n2o_*`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_manure()` output `N2O_D_MM_kgCO2e_livcat`, converted from package CO2-equivalent output to N2O using `GWP[["N20"]]`, then weighted by SYS02, rescaled and summed by category. | Table3.B(b), N2O **EMISSIONS** direct; livestock categories: cattle, dairy cattle, non-dairy cattle, swine, sheep, and poultry. |
| Table 3.B(b) | Emissions | Indirect manure N2O (`manure_indirect_n2o`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_manure()` outputs `N2O_G_mm_kgCO2e_livcat` and `N2O_L_mm_kgCO2e_livcat`, converted from package CO2-equivalent output to N2O using `GWP[["N20"]]`; species contributions are weighted by SYS02 and rescaled separately before summing. | Table3.B(b), N2O **EMISSIONS** indirect, sum of Atmospheric deposition and Nitrogen leaching and run-off. Reported separately as `3.B.5`, with no livestock-category detail. |
| Table 3.D | Emissions | Soil Direct N2O emissions (`soil_n2o_direct_*`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_msoils()` output `N2O_d_kgCO2e`, converted from package CO2-equivalent output to N2O using `GWP[["N20"]]`, then weighted by SYS02, rescaled and summed by category. | Table3.D, N2O **EMISSIONS**; category `3.D.1. Direct N2O emissions from managed soils`.  No livestock category detail. |
| Table 3.D | Emissions | Soil Indirect N2O emissions (`soil_n2o_indirect_*`) | `f_GHGE_n2o_msoils()` output `N2O_ATD_kgCO2e` and `N2O_L_kgCO2e`, converted from package CO2-equivalent output to N2O using `GWP[["N20"]]`, then weighted by SYS02, rescaled and summed by category. | Table3.D, N2O **EMISSIONS**; category `3.D.2. Indirect N2O Emissions from managed soils`.  No livestock category detail. |


```{r compare}
crt_data <- read.csv(
    crt_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("", "NA"),
    check.names = FALSE
)
crt_data <- crt_data |>
    filter(
        iso3 %in% c(
            my_object_raw@farm$Country_ISO_3166_1_A3,
            my_object_GHGE@farm$Country_ISO_3166_1_A3
        ),
        as.character(year) %in% as.character(c(
            my_object_raw@farm$YEAR, my_object_GHGE@farm$YEAR
        ))
    )
if (!nrow(crt_data)) {
    stop("No CRT records overlap the selected FADN countries and years.")
}

eurostat_population <- get0(
    "EUROSTAT_livestock_pop",
    envir = asNamespace("FADN2Footprint"),
    inherits = FALSE,
    ifnotfound = NULL
)
result <- h_unfccc_compare(
    my_object_GHGE,
    crt_data,
    rescale = TRUE,
    eurostat_population = eurostat_population
)
comparison <- result$comparison

livestock_emission_pattern <- paste0(
    "^(enteric_total|manure_total|enteric_ch4|manure_ch4|",
    "manure_direct_n2o)_(cattle|dairy_cattle|non_dairy_cattle|",
    "swine|sheep|poultry)$"
)
emission_rows <- comparison |>
    filter(grepl(livestock_emission_pattern, metric_id))

population_denominators <- comparison |>
    filter(grepl("^population_", metric_id)) |>
    transmute(
        iso3,
        YEAR,
        livcat = sub("^population_", "", metric_id),
        intensity_denominator_f2f = f2f_value,
        intensity_denominator_reference = population_reference_value
    )

area_denominators <- comparison |>
    filter(metric_id %in% c("area_cropland", "area_grassland")) |>
    summarise(
        intensity_denominator_f2f = h_unfccc_sum(ifelse(
            f2f_status == "ok",
            f2f_value,
            NA_real_
        )),
        intensity_denominator_reference = h_unfccc_sum(ifelse(
            crt_status == "ok",
            crt_value,
            NA_real_
        )),
        .by = c(iso3, YEAR)
    )

meat_codes <- c(
    cattle = "B1000",
    swine = "B3100",
    sheep = "B4100",
    poultry = "B7000"
)
meat_emission_rows <- emission_rows |>
    mutate(
        livcat = sub(
            "^.*_(cattle|dairy_cattle|non_dairy_cattle|swine|sheep|poultry)$",
            "\\1",
            metric_id
        )
    ) |>
    filter(livcat %in% names(meat_codes))

eurostat_meat <- tibble::tibble(
    iso3 = character(),
    YEAR = character(),
    meat_code = character(),
    meat_tonnes = numeric()
)
if (nrow(meat_emission_rows)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("The jsonlite package is required to retrieve Eurostat meat production.")
    }
    data_extra <- get("data_extra", envir = asNamespace("FADN2Footprint"))
    country_map <- data_extra$country_name |>
        transmute(
            geo = as.character(country_eu),
            iso3 = as.character(Country_ISO_3166_1_A3)
        ) |>
        filter(
            iso3 %in% unique(meat_emission_rows$iso3),
            !is.na(geo),
            !is.na(iso3)
        ) |>
        distinct()
    if (anyDuplicated(country_map$geo)) {
        stop("Eurostat country codes do not map uniquely to ISO3 codes.")
    }
    if (!nrow(country_map)) {
        stop("No selected countries have Eurostat country codes for meat production.")
    }
    eurostat_years <- sort(unique(as.character(meat_emission_rows$YEAR)))
    eurostat_query <- paste0(
        "format=JSON",
        paste0("&geo=", country_map$geo, collapse = ""),
        "&unit=THS_T&meatitem=SLAUGHT",
        paste0("&meat=", unname(meat_codes), collapse = ""),
        paste0("&time=", eurostat_years, collapse = "")
    )
    eurostat_url <- paste0(
        "https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/",
        "apro_mt_pann?",
        eurostat_query
    )
    eurostat_json <- paste(
        readLines(eurostat_url, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"),
        collapse = "\n"
    )
    eurostat_jsonstat <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
        eurostat_json,
        simplifyVector = FALSE
    )
    if (is.null(eurostat_jsonstat$id) || is.null(eurostat_jsonstat$value)) {
        stop("Eurostat returned no meat production observations.")
    }
    eurostat_meat <- parse_jsonstat(eurostat_jsonstat) |>
        filter(
            unit == "THS_T",
            meatitem == "SLAUGHT",
            meat %in% unname(meat_codes),
            is.finite(value)
        ) |>
        left_join(country_map, by = "geo", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
        transmute(
            iso3,
            YEAR = as.character(time),
            meat_code = as.character(meat),
            meat_tonnes = value * 1000
        )
    if (anyDuplicated(eurostat_meat[c("iso3", "YEAR", "meat_code")])) {
        stop("Eurostat meat production is not unique by country, year, and category.")
    }
}

h_unfccc_add_intensity <- function(
    data,
    suffix,
    unit_suffix,
    basis,
    denominator_source
) {
    kt_to_kg <- 1e6
    data |>
        mutate(
            metric_id = paste0(metric_id, suffix),
            unit = sub(
                "/year$",
                unit_suffix,
                sub("^kt ", "kg ", unit)
            ),
            f2f_value = if_else(
                is.finite(intensity_denominator_f2f) &
                    intensity_denominator_f2f > 0,
                f2f_value * kt_to_kg / intensity_denominator_f2f,
                NA_real_
            ),
            f2f_rescaled = if_else(
                is.finite(intensity_denominator_reference) &
                    intensity_denominator_reference > 0,
                f2f_rescaled * kt_to_kg / intensity_denominator_reference,
                NA_real_
            ),
            crt_value = if_else(
                is.finite(intensity_denominator_reference) &
                    intensity_denominator_reference > 0,
                crt_value * kt_to_kg / intensity_denominator_reference,
                NA_real_
            ),
            comparison_value = f2f_rescaled,
            comparison_basis = basis,
            intensity_denominator_source = denominator_source,
            f2f_status = case_when(
                f2f_status != "ok" ~ f2f_status,
                is.finite(intensity_denominator_f2f) &
                    intensity_denominator_f2f > 0 ~ "ok",
                TRUE ~ "missing_intensity_denominator"
            ),
            crt_status = case_when(
                crt_status != "ok" ~ crt_status,
                is.finite(intensity_denominator_reference) &
                    intensity_denominator_reference > 0 ~ "ok",
                TRUE ~ "missing_intensity_denominator"
            ),
            comparison_status = case_when(
                f2f_status != "ok" ~ f2f_status,
                crt_status != "ok" ~ crt_status,
                !is.finite(comparison_value) ~ "missing_intensity_value",
                TRUE ~ "ok"
            ),
            difference = if_else(
                comparison_status == "ok",
                comparison_value - crt_value,
                NA_real_
            ),
            relative_difference = h_unfccc_ratio(difference, crt_value),
            ratio = h_unfccc_ratio(
                if_else(comparison_status == "ok", comparison_value, NA_real_),
                crt_value
            )
        )
}

head_intensities <- emission_rows |>
    mutate(
        livcat = sub(
            "^.*_(cattle|dairy_cattle|non_dairy_cattle|swine|sheep|poultry)$",
            "\\1",
            metric_id
        )
    ) |>
    left_join(
        population_denominators,
        by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "livcat"),
        relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) |>
    h_unfccc_add_intensity(
        suffix = "_per_head",
        unit_suffix = "/head/year",
        basis = paste(
            "Per-head livestock emissions;",
            "FADN raw totals use FADN-weighted heads;",
            "rescaled FADN and CRT totals use the same CRT or Eurostat population."
        ),
        denominator_source = "FADN-weighted heads / CRT or Eurostat population"
    )

soil_intensities <- comparison |>
    filter(metric_id == "soil_total" | grepl("^soil_n2o_", metric_id)) |>
    left_join(
        area_denominators,
        by = c("iso3", "YEAR"),
        relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) |>
    h_unfccc_add_intensity(
        suffix = "_per_ha",
        unit_suffix = "/ha/year",
        basis = paste(
            "Per-hectare managed-soil emissions;",
            "FADN raw totals use FADN combined cropland and grassland;",
            "rescaled FADN and CRT totals use CRT combined area."
        ),
        denominator_source = "FADN combined cropland and grassland / CRT combined area"
    )

meat_intensities <- meat_emission_rows |>
    mutate(meat_code = unname(meat_codes[livcat])) |>
    left_join(
        eurostat_meat,
        by = c("iso3", "YEAR", "meat_code"),
        relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) |>
    mutate(
        intensity_denominator_f2f = meat_tonnes,
        intensity_denominator_reference = meat_tonnes
    ) |>
    h_unfccc_add_intensity(
        suffix = "_per_t_meat",
        unit_suffix = "/t meat",
        basis = paste(
            "Per-tonne-meat livestock emissions;",
            "FADN raw, rescaled FADN and CRT emissions use the same Eurostat",
            "country-year slaughtered-meat production denominator."
        ),
        denominator_source = "Eurostat slaughtered meat production (tonnes/year)"
    )

comparison <- bind_rows(
    comparison,
    head_intensities,
    soil_intensities,
    meat_intensities
)
metrics <- h_unfccc_metrics(comparison, rescale = TRUE) |>
    select(-comparison_basis) |>
    left_join(
        comparison |> distinct(metric_id, comparison_basis),
        by = "metric_id",
        relationship = "many-to-one"
    )
comparison$input_mode <- if (params$use_mock) "mock" else "real"
metrics$input_mode <- if (params$use_mock) "mock" else "real"

write.csv(
    comparison,
    file.path(output_dir, "UNFCCC_comparison.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
)
write.csv(
    result$catalogue,
    file.path(output_dir, "UNFCCC_comparison_catalogue.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
)
write.csv(
    metrics,
    file.path(output_dir, "UNFCCC_comparison_metrics.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
)
```

## Base variable catalogue

Every base measure has a row for every selected country-year, even when one side is unavailable. Derived intensity rows are added to the comparison and metrics exports; the authoritative base mappings and notes are exported to `UNFCCC_comparison_catalogue.csv` rather than displayed as a dense table.

## Population and area coverage

The chart compares SYS02-weighted totals from the constructor object (raw FADN) and the object after practice inference and GHG computation (FADN2Footprint) with available Eurostat livestock populations. Each CRT value is the 100% reference; bars are omitted when that reference is unavailable or zero. The FADN2Footprint totals are used to calculate the report's coverage ratios; differences between the bars can reflect farms removed during processing. The Eurostat dataset averages reported livestock survey periods and does not include poultry or land areas. Eurostat bars are loaded separately for visualization and do not by themselves enable the rescaling fallback.

```{r coverage}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

eurostat_coverage <- eurostat_population
if (is.null(eurostat_coverage)) {
    package_data <- utils::data(package = "FADN2Footprint")$results
    if (!is.null(package_data) &&
        "EUROSTAT_livestock_pop" %in% package_data[, "Item"]) {
        data_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
        utils::data(
            list = "EUROSTAT_livestock_pop",
            package = "FADN2Footprint",
            envir = data_env
        )
        eurostat_coverage <- get("EUROSTAT_livestock_pop", envir = data_env)
    } else {
        cat("Eurostat population data are unavailable; run the population builder to add them.\n")
    }
}

coverage_plot_data <- h_unfccc_coverage_plot_data(
    h_unfccc_fadn(my_object_raw, result$catalogue, coverage_only = TRUE),
    comparison,
    h_unfccc_inventory(crt_data, result$catalogue),
    eurostat_coverage
)

if (nrow(coverage_plot_data)) {
    country_years <- levels(coverage_plot_data$country_year)
    pages <- split(country_years, ceiling(seq_along(country_years) / 12))
    for (page in seq_along(pages)) {
        page_data <- filter(coverage_plot_data, country_year %in% pages[[page]])
        print(
            ggplot(
                page_data,
                aes(x = country_year, y = coverage_percent, fill = estimate)
            ) +
                geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
                geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
                facet_wrap(~metric_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
                labs(
                    title = "FADN coverage relative to UNFCCC CRT",
                    subtitle = paste("Page", page, "of", length(pages)),
                    x = "Country - year",
                    y = "Coverage relative to CRT (%)",
                    fill = NULL,
                    caption = "The dashed line is the CRT reference (100%)."
                ) +
                theme_minimal() +
                theme(
                    legend.position = "bottom",
                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)
                )
        )
    }
} else {
    cat("No valid CRT/FADN coverage comparisons are available.\n")
}
```

## Coverage and diagnostics

Farm-level quantities are expanded **once** with the FADN sampling weight `SYS02`; livestock numbers are heads, not livestock units. Gross energy intake is weighted by **heads times SYS02**, then converted from MJ/head/year to MJ/head/day using the package's 365-day convention. Cattle totals include dairy and non-dairy cattle, while each subgroup is also shown separately.

CH4 and N2O are recovered from package CO2-equivalent outputs using the package's own `GWP` values, not hard-coded inventory factors. Gas emissions are in kt gas/year; Table 3 totals are in kt CO2-eq/year; nitrogen is in t N/year; production is t/year; area is ha.

**Interpretation limits:**

-   Organic fertilizer activity and N2O emissions are compared at the combined `3.D.1.b` category. Origin-specific subdivisions are excluded because the package does not distinguish them.
-   Package manure volatilisation includes NH3 and NOx, not N2. That value is shown as a proxy, with no numerical equivalence statistics.
-   Summing indirect-soil activity pathways can count the same N input twice; the combined activity is marked as a proxy, not a unique total nitrogen input.
-   Grazing deposits are approximated by organic fertilization of grassland.
-   Direct soil emissions omit drained organic soils and soil organic matter mineralisation in the current package.
-   Table 3 manure livestock totals include CH4 and direct N2O; indirect N2O is reported separately under 3.B.5, avoiding double counting.
-   Cropland includes package arable and fallow areas (including permanent crops), not forest/other land. Inventory land definitions and FADN coverage differ.
-   Wheat combines common and durum wheat; maize is grain maize, not forage maize. Table 3.F production can have narrower coverage where residues are not burned.
-   Package factors themselves use inventory reference data: this is a descriptive comparison, **not independent validation**.
-   If the manure routine reports a missing EF3 for a positive allocation, its affected comparisons carry `model_error` and the exact error text. No factor is guessed, and no partial manure total is reported. Other model errors stop the report. This is an existing limitation for combined solid-storage/dry-lot systems in the current reference data.
-   When CRT population values are unavailable, livestock rescaling uses `EUROSTAT_livestock_pop` only if it is available as a direct package-namespace binding; the coverage chart separately loads the package dataset and does not enable the fallback. The builder averages the reported Eurostat population periods within each year; total cattle, dairy cows, pigs, sheep and goats use Eurostat's live-animal categories, with non-dairy cattle calculated as total cattle minus dairy cows. Poultry is not covered by this fallback. The Eurostat reference value and source are retained in the comparison export. If the fallback is unavailable or a category is missing, affected rescaled comparisons remain unavailable.

```{r diagnostics}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6

comparison |>
    count(sheet, f2f_status, crt_status, name = "comparisons") |>
    mutate(status = paste(f2f_status, crt_status, sep = " / ")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = comparisons, y = sheet, fill = status)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(
        title = "Country-year comparison status by CRT table",
        x = "Country-year comparisons",
        y = "CRT sheet",
        fill = "F2F / CRT status"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

diagnostics <- comparison |>
    filter(
        f2f_status != "ok" |
            crt_status != "ok" |
            comparison_status != "ok" |
            is.na(crt_unit_check) |
            crt_unit_check != "OK"
    ) |>
    select(
        iso3,
        YEAR,
        metric_id,
        f2f_status,
        f2f_error,
        crt_status,
        crt_flag,
        crt_unit_check,
        comparison_status,
        comparison_basis,
        population_reference_value,
        population_reference_source,
        note
    )
write.csv(
    diagnostics,
    file.path(output_dir, "UNFCCC_comparison_diagnostics.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
)
cat(
    nrow(diagnostics),
    "diagnostic rows exported to UNFCCC_comparison_diagnostics.csv."
)
```

# Agreement metrics and intensities

For each variable/category, matched country-years are summarized with equal weight, using **UNFCCC as the reference**. Different variables and units are never pooled. **All totals other than area and livestock population use coverage-rescaled F2F estimates** $\hat{y}_i$ for country-year $i$ and UNFCCC reference $y_i$. Livestock totals use the matching CRT/F2F population ratio; soil and crop totals use the CRT/F2F combined cropland-plus-grassland area ratio. Indirect manure contributions are rescaled separately by species before summing for comparison with CRT `3.B.5`; they are not included in the species-level manure totals. **Only area and population coverage comparisons use raw totals.** Gross energy intake is an explicitly unchanged per-head exception (MJ/head/day), not a total to rescale.

Emission totals are also reported as intensities. Managed-soil emissions are divided by combined cropland and grassland area. Livestock emissions are divided by matching livestock population, and by annual Eurostat slaughtered-meat production for cattle, pigs, sheep and poultry; dairy and non-dairy cattle are not split for meat intensity because Eurostat does not provide separate meat totals for those groups. Raw FADN per-head values use FADN-weighted heads; rescaled FADN and CRT values use the same CRT population reference, with the documented Eurostat fallback where CRT population is unavailable. Per-tonne values use the same Eurostat country-year meat production denominator for both emission sources. Each intensity has its own unit and comparison basis.

-   **Mean Percentage Error (MPE)**: $\frac{100}{n} \cdot \sum_i{\frac{\hat{y}_i-y_i}{y_i}}$. Positive values indicate overestimation; negative values indicate underestimation. Errors of opposite signs can cancel.
-   **Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)**: $\frac{100}{n} \cdot \sum_i{\frac{|\hat{y}_i-y_i|}{y_i}}$. Lower values indicate smaller percentage errors.
-   **Coefficient of Determination (R²)**: $1-\frac{\sum_i (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2}{\sum_i (y_i-\overline{y})^2}$, where each difference is squared before summing. A value of 1 indicates perfect agreement; 0 matches the reference-mean predictor; negative values indicate worse agreement than that predictor. This is **not squared correlation**.

::: {#tbl-agreement-metrics}
| Metric | Question | Reading |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| MAPE | How large is the percentage error across country-years? | \< 20% good, 20–50% acceptable, \> 50% poor |
| MPE | Does the package over- or underestimate on average? | \> 0 over, \< 0 under; t-test p-value \> 0.05 means no detected systematic bias |
| R² | How close are the estimates to the UNFCCC values? | 1 perfect, \> 0.5 satisfactory, \< 0 worse than the UNFCCC mean |
:::

Only finite pairs with both statuses `ok` are included. Zero UNFCCC references are excluded from MPE/MAPE but retained for R². In the percentage formulas, $n$ is the number of valid pairs with nonzero references (`n_percentage_pairs`); the reference mean for R² uses all valid pairs (`n_pairs`). MAPE follows the formula above with the absolute value only in the numerator; it assumes positive references for interpretation as a nonnegative error. R² is `NA` when fewer than two valid pairs remain or the UNFCCC reference is constant. MPE/MAPE are `NA` when no nonzero reference pairs remain. Counts and status columns make these cases explicit. MPE/MAPE are stored in **percentage units** (10 means 10%), while R² is dimensionless. The summaries are exported to `UNFCCC_comparison_metrics.csv`.

The MPE test is a **two-sided one-sample t-test of individual country-year percentage errors against zero**, not a test on the single summarized MPE. Its unadjusted p-value and 95% confidence interval (percentage units) are exported with the test statistic, degrees of freedom and test status. Fewer than two errors, nonfinite errors or essentially constant errors (including agreement within machine precision after rescaling) make the test unavailable; no p-value is invented. A p-value above 0.05 is not proof of unbiasedness. Repeated years for a country may not be independent, and testing many variables increases the chance of false positives; these tests are exploratory.

Summary heatmaps show the aggregate metrics and apply the thresholds above. MPE tile colours reflect its t-test, while its signed value indicates the direction of the error. Undefined values/tests are grey. Each page contains at most 12 variables, with valid pair counts beside their names. Every plot caption identifies the estimate basis. Missing scaling factors never fall back to raw totals. Raw values are retained in CSV exports for traceability, but differences and metrics use `comparison_value` and `comparison_basis`.

# Selected comparisons

The difference is **FADN2Footprint minus CRT**; relative difference divides by CRT. A zero or missing CRT denominator produces `NA`, never infinity. Proxy and unavailable measures are excluded from numerical difference statistics and plots.

Scatterplots use raw values only for areas and livestock populations, to show the coverage divergence. Other livestock emissions and activity totals use the matching CRT/F2F livestock-population ratio; soil and crop totals use the combined cropland-plus-grassland area ratio. Each plot caption states which ratio was applied. Gross energy intake is an average per head, so these total-coverage ratios do not apply; its plots explicitly identify this unchanged per-head exception. Measures without a valid rescaled estimate are omitted, never replaced with raw values.

Emission totals and derived intensities are plotted separately by physical unit. Per-head and per-hectare comparisons use source-appropriate denominators; per-tonne-meat comparisons are available for cattle, pigs, sheep and poultry only. Combined indirect manure N2O remains a national total because the CRT does not provide livestock-category detail for that measure.

Each country-year heatmap tile is the relative difference $\frac{FADN2Footprint - CRT}{CRT} \cdot 100$. Negative values indicate underestimation; positive values indicate overestimation. Grey tiles indicate unavailable comparisons or a zero CRT reference. Labels show the actual percentage; colours are capped at ±100%.

```{r selected_reports}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8

for (section_index in seq_len(nrow(selected))) {
    section <- selected[section_index, ]
    cat("\n\n## ", section$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(
        "Workbook row ", section$workbook_row, "; ",
        section$type, "; ", section$crt_table, ".\n\n",
        sep = ""
    )
    pages <- h_unfccc_section_pages(comparison, section$metric_ids[[1]])
    for (page_index in seq_along(pages)) {
        page <- pages[[page_index]]
        page_metrics <- metrics |>
            dplyr::filter(
                metric_id %in% page$metric_id,
                sheet == page$sheet[1],
                unit == page$unit[1],
                estimate == page$estimate[1],
                comparison_basis == page$comparison_basis[1]
            )
        cat(
            "\n\n### ", page$sheet[1], " - ", page$unit[1],
            " (", page$estimate[1], "; page ", page_index, ")\n\n",
            page$comparison_basis[1], "\n\n",
            sep = ""
        )
        cat("\n\n#### CRT versus FADN2Footprint\n\n")
        scatter <- h_unfccc_scatter_plot(page)
        if (!nrow(scatter$data)) {
            cat("No valid pairs are available for this scatterplot. See diagnostics.\n\n")
        }
        print(scatter)
        cat("\n\n#### Country-year relative errors\n\n")
        print(h_unfccc_country_year_plot(page, page_metrics))
        cat("\n\n#### Agreement metrics\n\n")
        print(h_unfccc_metric_plot(page_metrics))
    }
}
```

# Coverage rescaling and interpretation

Raw SYS02-expanded estimates are retained for traceability only, except for the area and livestock population coverage comparisons used to calculate ratios. Coverage rescaling is mandatory for all other totals, including their differences, MAPE, MPE, t-tests and R². Soil/crop quantities use **one combined cropland-plus-grassland area ratio per country-year**, not a separate ratio for each land-use row. Gross energy averages remain unchanged and are labelled as a per-head exception.

Species-level manure totals include CH4 and direct N2O only, matching the CRT species-category boundary. The separate indirect manure N2O comparison uses quantities split by species, multiplied by each species' CRT/F2F population ratio, and then summed for comparison with the combined CRT 3.B.5 total. Cattle is counted once, not again through its dairy/non-dairy subgroups. The population catalogue covers cattle, swine, sheep and poultry; if any contributing species lacks a valid population ratio, the entire indirect total is unavailable. This boundary adjustment applies only to the UNFCCC comparison; all manure pathways remain in the full farm footprint. Proxy quantities remain excluded. Zero, missing, non-equivalent or invalid-status denominators do not generate factors; unavailable rescaled comparisons are recorded in diagnostics.


These adjustments are **not validation**: matching the denominator can remove a coverage discrepancy by construction, and a single area ratio assumes representative land use and practices.
